events.titleZh: 2024欧洲杯罚丢点球痛哭 — 自我救赎还是抢戏？
events.titleEn: Euro 2024 Penalty Miss & Tears — Redemption or Scene-Stealing?
events.summaryZh: 加时赛114分钟主罚点球被奥布拉克扑出，39岁C罗当场痛哭；点球大战第一罚将功补过。本该是团队晋级之夜，叙事主角却又是他自己。
events.summaryEn: In the 114th minute of extra time his penalty was saved by Oblak; 39-year-old Ronaldo burst into tears on the pitch, then took the first kick in the shootout to make amends. A night that should have belonged to the team became, once again, all about him.
events.detailZh:
120分钟的窒息：2024年7月1日，欧洲杯1/8决赛，葡萄牙对阵斯洛文尼亚。常规时间0-0，加时赛上半场补时阶段（第114分钟），葡萄牙获得点球——这是绝杀的黄金机会。 关键罚丢：39岁的C罗主罚，却被马竞老对手、斯洛文尼亚门将奥布拉克（Jan Oblak）神勇扑出，皮球撞立柱弹出。C罗整场比赛此前已浪费5-6次绝佳机会，这次点球本可救赎一切，却以最残酷的方式告吹。 当场落泪：点球罚丢后，镜头捕捉到C罗眼眶泛红、当场落泪，加时赛休息期间队友纷纷上前安慰、亲吻额头。看台上的母亲同样泪流满面——这一幕迅速成为本届欧洲杯最出圈的画面。 点球大战的自我救赎：进入点球大战，C罗主动要求第一罚，低射破门将功补过。队友科斯塔（Diogo Costa）更神勇扑出对方全部三粒点球，葡萄牙3-0晋级。本应是「门将封神之夜」，可赛后舆论焦点又回到了C罗身上。 「抢戏」的争议：批评者指出：晋级功劳应归于扑出三粒点球的科斯塔，但C罗的眼泪、C罗的救赎、C罗的「第一罚」抢走了全部叙事。媒体称之为「The Cristiano Ronaldo Show」——无论成败，主角永远只能是他。 「整届赛事0球」的尴尬：39岁的C罗整届欧洲杯颗粒无收（0进球1助攻），成为队史最年长却也是最沉寂的核心。罚丢点球不过是这种衰退的集中爆发——那个曾经凭一己之力决定比赛的男人，正在被时间一点点剥夺主角光环。 主教练的力挺与反讽：主帅马丁内斯赛后力挺：「他是我们的榜样……错过点球后主动第一个罚，是典范。」但这番「力挺」本身也充满反讽——一个需要教练反复强调「他很重要」的核心，恰恰说明他的重要性已经需要被论证了。
⚠️ 免责声明：本档案依据 ESPN、CNN、Sky Sports 等公开报道整理。比赛结果与数据均可查证，对叙事主角的讨论属媒体评论。
events.detailEn:
120 minutes of suffocation: On 1 July 2024, in the Euro round of 16, Portugal faced Slovenia. Regulation ended 0-0; in the first-half stoppage time of extra time (114th minute) Portugal were awarded a penalty — a golden chance to win it. The costly miss: The 39-year-old Ronaldo took it, only for Slovenian keeper (and long-time Atlético foe) Jan Oblak to make a stunning save, the ball striking the post and bouncing away. Ronaldo had already wasted 5-6 great chances in the match; this penalty could have redeemed everything, but ended in the cruellest way. Tears on the spot: After the miss, cameras caught Ronaldo red-eyed and weeping on the pitch; during the extra-time interval teammates flocked to console and kiss his forehead. His mother in the stands was also in tears — a moment that quickly became the most-viral image of the Euros. Shootout redemption: In the shootout Ronaldo asked to take the first kick and slotted it low to make amends. Teammate Diogo Costa went further, saving all three Slovenian penalties, and Portugal went through 3-0. It should have been 'the keeper's night', but the post-match narrative swung back to Ronaldo. The 'scene-stealing' controversy: Critics argued the credit belonged to Costa, who saved three penalties, but Ronaldo's tears, Ronaldo's redemption, Ronaldo's 'first kick' hogged the entire narrative. The media dubbed it 'The Cristiano Ronaldo Show' — win or lose, the protagonist can only ever be him. The '0 goals for the tournament' awkwardness: The 39-year-old Ronaldo finished the Euros goalless (0 goals, 1 assist), the oldest but also quietest focal point in Portugal's history. The penalty miss was simply the concentrated eruption of this decline — the man who once decided matches alone is being slowly stripped of his leading-man halo by time. The manager's backing, and the irony: Manager Martínez backed him afterwards: 'He is our role model… to take the first penalty after missing shows his character.' But the 'backing' itself is steeped in irony — a core who needs the coach to keep insisting 'he matters' is precisely a sign that his importance now has to be argued.
⚠️ Disclaimer: This file is compiled from public reporting by ESPN, CNN, Sky Sports and others. Match results and data are all verifiable; discussion of the narrative protagonist reflects media commentary.

events.titleZh: 抢单刀废队友 — 伊瓜因空门被C罗挡出
events.titleEn: Snatching the Breakaway — Blocked Higuaín's Open Goal
events.summaryZh: 伊瓜因过掉门将面对空门，C罗挤过去想自己进球、挡掉队友必进球路线；伊瓜因后公开炮轰「他太自负，不夸他最好就不爽」，并对比梅西「两人完全不一样」。
events.summaryEn: Higuaín rounded the keeper to face an open goal, but Ronaldo barged in trying to score himself and blocked his teammate's certain goal; Higuaín later publicly blasted him — 'he's too full of himself, if you don't praise him as the best he sulks', contrasting Messi — 'the two are nothing alike'.
events.detailZh:
名场面：挡掉伊瓜因空门：皇马时期，伊瓜因一次反越位成功、过掉门将面对空门，本可轻松推射得分。C罗却从侧后方挤入禁区，试图自己抢点射门，结果两人撞在一起、球也没进。这一幕被做成视频「Cristiano Ronaldo selfishness costs Higuain a goal」广泛流传——宁可自己不进，也不能让队友进。 「抢点球/抢任意球」传统：这并非孤例。C罗在皇马、尤文都以「抢点球权」著称：本该由当场比赛状态更好的队友主罚的点球，他常坚持自己来；任意球更是几乎独占，哪怕命中率已断崖式下滑。伊瓜因、本泽马、迪巴拉都曾是这种「球权独占」的牺牲品。 伊瓜因的公开炮轰：离开皇马转投那不勒斯后，伊瓜因在接受西班牙《Don Balon》杂志采访时公开批评C罗：「他太自负了。你不夸他是最好的，他就不是你朋友。C罗 自以为最好，但他被高估了。」并直接拿梅西做对比：「我跟梅西共用过一个更衣室，两个人完全不一样。」 那不勒斯的「否认」：这番言论引发轩然大波后，伊瓜因当时效力的那不勒斯俱乐部紧急发声明「否认伊瓜因接受过该采访」，称「相关言论被视为虚假且毫无根据」。但多家媒体（Bleacher Report、Mirror、Sport）已广泛转载，伊瓜因本人也未就言论内容本身明确反驳——「否认采访」和「否认说过」之间，留足了想象空间。 离开皇马的导火索之一：伊瓜因 2013 年以 3700 万欧元转投那不勒斯，外界普遍认为他与C罗的球权之争、以及在皇马被迫给C罗让位的压抑，是离队的重要诱因之一。他本人在不同场合暗示过，皇马的战术「一切围绕C罗」，前锋队友只是配角。 尤文时期的二次挤压：命运弄人——2018 年 C罗 转投尤文图斯，而伊瓜因当时正是尤文前锋。C罗一来，伊瓜因立刻被外租（先后至 AC 米兰、切尔西），彻底失去位置。尤文与米兰一役中，伊瓜因情绪彻底崩溃：骂裁判、怼C罗、吼基耶利尼，最终红牌罚下——多年积压的怨气，在重逢「老队友」时一齐爆发。 本泽马的「自我牺牲」对照：同样与C罗共事的本泽马走了相反的路——主动化身「绿叶」，做支点、做策应、把射门权让给C罗。本泽马多次公开为C罗辩护「他不是自私」，但这恰恰反向证明：和C罗共存的前提是你必须自我牺牲，否则就是伊瓜因的下场。
⚠️ 免责声明：本档案依据 Bleacher Report、Mirror、Sport、懂球帝、知乎专栏等公开报道整理。伊瓜因「炮轰C罗」的采访那不勒斯俱乐部曾否认其真实性；场上「挡空门」一事为流传视频，具体赛事场次有待进一步核实。内容仅供娱乐。
events.detailEn:
The open-goal block on Higuaín: During the Real Madrid years Higuaín once sprang the offside trap, rounded the keeper and faced an open goal, an easy tap-in. Yet Ronaldo barged into the box from a rear angle to try to finish it himself, the two collided and the ball went begging. The moment was edited into a widely circulated video 'Cristiano Ronaldo selfishness costs Higuain a goal' — better neither score than let a teammate score. The 'penalty/free-kick grabbing' tradition: Far from isolated. Ronaldo was famed at Madrid and Juve for 'grabbing penalty duties': penalties that should have gone to in-form teammates he often insisted on taking; free-kicks were almost exclusively his, even as his conversion rate fell off a cliff. Higuaín, Benzema and Dybala all fell victim to this 'ball-hogging'. Higuaín's public blast: After leaving Real for Napoli, Higuaín publicly criticised Ronaldo in an interview with Spain's Don Balon magazine: 'He's too full of himself. If you don't praise him as the best, he's not your friend. Cristiano thinks he's the best, but he's overrated.' He then drew a direct comparison with Messi: 'I shared a dressing room with Messi — the two are completely different.' Napoli's 'denial': After the remarks caused a stir, Higuaín's then club Napoli rushed out a statement 'denying that Higuaín had given the interview', calling 'the relevant quotes fabricated and groundless'. But multiple outlets (Bleacher Report, Mirror, Sport) had already widely reproduced them, and Higuaín himself never explicitly refuted the substance — plenty of room between 'denying the interview' and 'denying having said it'. A spark for leaving Real: Higuaín joined Napoli in 2013 for €37 million; the consensus is that his ball-rights feud with Ronaldo, and the oppressive feeling of being forced to play second fiddle, were major reasons for the move. He himself has hinted in various settings that Madrid's tactics 'were all about Ronaldo' and that the striker partners were merely supporting cast. Squeezed again at Juve: Cruelly, in 2018 Ronaldo moved to Juventus — where Higuaín was the striker. The moment Ronaldo arrived, Higuaín was loaned out (to AC Milan, then Chelsea) and lost his place entirely. In a Juve-Milan match Higuaín completely melted down: cursing the referee, squaring up to Ronaldo, bellowing at Chiellini, and finally getting sent off — years of pent-up resentment erupting at the reunion with the 'old teammate'. Benzema's 'self-sacrifice' contrast: Benzema, who also played with Ronaldo, took the opposite path — actively becoming the 'supporting leaf', holding up the play, providing the link, ceding the finishing to Ronaldo. Benzema publicly defended Ronaldo multiple times as 'not selfish', but that itself inversely proves: the price of coexisting with Ronaldo is you have to sacrifice yourself — otherwise you get the Higuaín treatment.
⚠️ Disclaimer: This file is compiled from public reporting by Bleacher Report, Mirror, Sport, Dongqiudi, Zhihu columns and others. Napoli once denied the authenticity of the interview in which Higuaín 'blasted Ronaldo'; the 'blocked open goal' moment is a circulating video whose specific fixture awaits further verification. Content for entertainment only.

quote.textZh: 他太自负了。你不夸他是最好的，他就不是你朋友。我跟梅西共用过更衣室，两个人完全不一样。
quote.textEn: He's too full of himself. If you don't call him the best, he's not your friend. I shared a dressing room with Messi—they're two completely different people.
quote.authorZh: 伊瓜因，据《Don Balon》杂志报道（那不勒斯事后否认）
quote.authorEn: Gonzalo Higuaín, per Don Balón magazine (later denied by Napoli)

quotes.textZh: 我感到被背叛了。曼联的人——教练、高层——他们背叛了我。
quotes.textEn: I feel betrayed. The people at Manchester United — the coach, the hierarchy — they betrayed me.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2022年皮尔斯·摩根采访
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, 2022 Piers Morgan interview

quotes.textZh: 是我在这里，不是梅西！
quotes.textEn: I'm here, not Messi!
quotes.authorZh: C罗，沙特联赛回应球迷挑衅
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, responding to fan taunts in the Saudi league

quotes.textZh: 喝水，不要可乐。
quotes.textEn: Drink water, not Coca-Cola.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2021欧洲杯发布会
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, Euro 2020 press conference

quotes.textZh: 世界杯不是我的梦想。我就是历史第一、第二、第三。
quotes.textEn: The World Cup is not my dream. I am the first, second and third best in history.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2025年11月皮尔斯·摩根专访
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, Nov 2025 Piers Morgan interview

quotes.textZh: 我之所以被嘘，是因为我长得帅、又有钱、还踢得伟大，人们就是嫉妒我。
quotes.textEn: I get booed because I'm handsome, rich and play brilliantly — people are just jealous.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2016年金球奖颁奖后回应争议
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, after the 2016 Ballon d'Or, responding to criticism

quotes.textZh: 你们之所以要查我，是因为我是C罗。
quotes.textEn: The only reason you're investigating me is because I'm Cristiano Ronaldo.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2017年逃税案庭审
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, 2017 tax-fraud court hearing

quotes.textZh: Factos! Factos! Factos!
quotes.textEn: Factos! Factos! Factos!
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2021年金球奖输给梅西后深夜在梅西帖子下的连发评论
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, comments spammed under Messi's post after losing the 2021 Ballon d'Or

quotes.textZh: 我1000%问心无愧，我顶着压力打进3球，表现不差。
quotes.textEn: I'm 1000% at peace with my conscience. I scored 3 goals under pressure, my performance was not bad.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2026世界杯1/8决赛前一天发布会
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, press conference the day before the 2026 World Cup R16

quotes.textZh: 在我之前，葡萄牙什么都没赢过。我帮葡萄牙拿了三座奖杯，欧洲杯不亚于世界杯。
quotes.textEn: Before me, Portugal had won nothing. I won them three trophies — the Euros are no less than the World Cup.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2026世界杯出局后自辩
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, defending himself after the 2026 World Cup exit

quotes.textZh: 明天无论如何，我都1000%问心无愧。
quotes.textEn: No matter what tomorrow, I'm 1000% at peace with my conscience.
quotes.authorZh: C罗，2026世界杯赛前发布会（与赛后同一句，被嘲'输了也背词'）
quotes.authorEn: Cristiano, pre-match press conference (the same line reused after — mocked for 'memorizing lines even when losing')

quotes.textZh: 把阿伟罗这个父姓给彻底扔了，除了蹭热度并且想要掩盖事实以外，实在是没觉得有什么别的可能。
quotes.textEn: Ditching the family name Aveiro — apart from chasing hype and covering up the truth, there's really no other explanation.
quotes.authorZh: 知乎足球评论，论背弃祖姓
quotes.authorEn: Zhihu football commentary, on abandoning the surname

quotes.textZh: 更加喜欢的是表里如一、行不更名坐不改姓的人，那样显得更真实更有自信。
quotes.textEn: I prefer someone who's the same inside and out, who doesn't change his name — that reads as more real, more confident.
quotes.authorZh: 网易体育评论
quotes.authorEn: NetEase Sports commentary

quotes.textZh: 无论是面对球迷、记者、裁判、对手，无论是20多岁还是39岁，C罗都容易'上头'。
quotes.textEn: Whether facing fans, journalists, referees or opponents, in his 20s or at 39, Cristiano easily loses his head.
quotes.authorZh: 腾讯体育评论
quotes.authorEn: Tencent Sports commentary

quotes.textZh: 2013年是破坏了规则，而2010年在规则之内。
quotes.textEn: 2013 broke the rules; 2010 stayed within them.
quotes.authorZh: 知乎足球评论，论金球延期丑闻
quotes.authorEn: Zhihu football commentary, on the Ballon d'Or extension scandal

quotes.textZh: 来沙特快4年！C罗，终于在联赛夺冠了！
quotes.textEn: Almost 4 years in Saudi! Cristiano finally wins the league!
quotes.authorZh: 澎湃新闻2026年5月22日
quotes.authorEn: The Paper, May 22, 2026

quotes.textZh: 六届世界杯、九场淘汰赛、仅一粒进球、零座奖杯——'历史最佳'的尽头是一张写满零的答卷。
quotes.textEn: Six World Cups, nine knockout games, one single goal, zero trophies — the end of the "GOAT" is a report card full of zeros.
quotes.authorZh: ESPN，2026世界杯1/8决赛后
quotes.authorEn: ESPN, after the 2026 World Cup R16

quotes.textZh: The King leaves without his crown（王无冠而退）。
quotes.textEn: The King leaves without his crown.
quotes.authorZh: LiveMint，2026世界杯葡萄牙出局头条
quotes.authorEn: LiveMint, headline after Portugal's 2026 World Cup exit

quotes.textZh: 2016欧洲杯决赛他25分钟就伤退，是替补埃德的远射捧回了奖杯，可叙事的主角永远还得是他自己。
quotes.textEn: He went off injured in the 25th minute of the Euro 2016 final; substitute Éder's long shot won the trophy — yet the story's protagonist always has to be him.
quotes.authorZh: 体坛加，2026世界杯赛后评论
quotes.authorEn: Titan Sports, post-2026 World Cup commentary

quotes.textZh: 这不是输球，是输不起——每一次出局后，剧本的主角永远只能是他自己。
quotes.textEn: This isn't losing a match — it's being a sore loser. After every exit, the lead role of the script can only ever be him.
quotes.authorZh: 凤凰网体育，论'问心无愧'话术
quotes.authorEn: Phoenix Sports, on the "clear conscience" rhetoric

quotes.textZh: 赛前预埋一句、赛后兑现同一句，输了也要赢话术，这叫'冠军心态'。
quotes.textEn: Plant a line before the match, repeat the same line after — even when you lose you win the rhetoric. That's "champion mentality."
quotes.authorZh: 知乎，论C罗的赛后发言模板
quotes.authorEn: Zhihu, on Cristiano's post-match talking template

quotes.textZh: 和C罗做队友你得做好准备：球权是他的，镜头也是他的。
quotes.textEn: If you're Cristiano's teammate, be ready: the ball is his, and so is the camera.
quotes.authorZh: 匿名前皇马队友，《马卡报》专栏
quotes.authorEn: Anonymous former Real Madrid teammate, Marca column

quotes.textZh: 对C罗来说，没有进球的比赛就是失败的比赛，哪怕球队赢了。
quotes.textEn: For Cristiano, a game without a goal is a failed game — even if the team won.
quotes.authorZh: 哈维，巴萨名宿
quotes.authorEn: Xavi, Barcelona legend

quotes.textZh: 我亲眼目睹C罗踢了三脚！却被裁判告知这不是红牌。
quotes.textEn: I saw Cristiano kick him three times with my own eyes! Yet the referee told me it wasn't a red.
quotes.authorZh: 克洛普，利物浦主帅
quotes.authorEn: Jürgen Klopp, Liverpool manager

quotes.textZh: 一个永远在追赶大力神杯、却始终差一步的男人——但合影里的C位，他一步都不肯让。
quotes.textEn: A man forever chasing the World Cup trophy yet always one step short — but in the group photo, he won't yield center stage by an inch.
quotes.authorZh: 新浪体育，2026世界杯告别特写
quotes.authorEn: Sina Sports, 2026 World Cup farewell feature

quotes.textZh: 摔手机、扔麦克风、摔袖标、不雅动作——这不是巨星脾气，是失控。
quotes.textEn: Smashing phones, throwing mics, tossing armbands, obscene gestures — this isn't star temper, it's losing control.
quotes.authorZh: BBC Sport，盘点C罗场外失态
quotes.authorEn: BBC Sport, rounding up Cristiano's off-pitch meltdowns

quotes.textZh: 他不是没有天赋，而是天赋之上又加了一层永远填不满的自我。
quotes.textEn: It's not that he lacks talent — it's that on top of his talent there's a layer of self that can never be filled.
quotes.authorZh: 腾讯体育，深度人物评论
quotes.authorEn: Tencent Sports, in-depth profile

quotes.textZh: 40亿美元市值蒸发，只因一句'喝水，不要可乐'——傲慢的代价由股东买单。
quotes.textEn: $40 billion in market cap wiped out by one line, "drink water, not Coke" — the price of arrogance paid by shareholders.
quotes.authorZh: CNN，2021可口可乐事件评论
quotes.authorEn: CNN, on the 2021 Coca-Cola incident

quotes.textZh: 在沙特刷数据，再和欧洲时期的数据简单相加，这本身就注水了。
quotes.textEn: Padding stats in Saudi and simply adding them to his European totals — that's water-injected by definition.
quotes.authorZh: 虎扑，论沙特进球含金量
quotes.authorEn: Hupu, on the value of Saudi-league goals

quotes.textZh: 他是我带过最自我中心的球员。
quotes.textEn: He's the most self-centred player I've ever coached.
quotes.authorZh: 穆里尼奥，前皇马主帅
quotes.authorEn: José Mourinho, former Real Madrid manager

quotes.textZh: 如果连队友的红牌都能换来一个挤眼的微笑，那这种胜利观已经病态了。
quotes.textEn: If a teammate's red card can be met with a wink and a smile, then this idea of winning is already pathological.
quotes.authorZh: 《每日镜报》，论2006世界杯'眨眼门'
quotes.authorEn: Daily Mirror, on the 2006 World Cup "wink gate"

quotes.textZh: 他不是为葡萄牙而战，是为'C罗'而战。
quotes.textEn: He doesn't fight for Portugal — he fights for "Cristiano Ronaldo."
quotes.authorZh: 葡萄牙《球报》，2022世界杯替补风波后
quotes.authorEn: Portuguese daily A Bola, after the 2022 World Cup benching saga

quotes.textZh: 7亿欧元的解约金，换不来一个愿意为球队回追的7号。
quotes.textEn: A €700M release clause can't buy a No.7 willing to track back for the team.
quotes.authorZh: 塞尔电台，皇马后期更衣室分歧报道
quotes.authorEn: Cadena SER, reporting late-era Real Madrid dressing-room splits

quotes.textZh: 儿子迷你罗的生母是谁，他守口如瓶——一个把人生都做成保密协议的男人。
quotes.textEn: Who is Cristiano Jr's mother? He won't say a word — a man who's turned his whole life into an NDA.
quotes.authorZh: 知天下，论迷你罗生母之谜
quotes.authorEn: Zhihu Tianxia, on the Cristiano Jr. mother mystery

quotes.textZh: 十二任女友、五个孩子、三个生母——他把私生活踢成了转会市场。
quotes.textEn: Twelve girlfriends, five children, three mothers — he's turned his private life into a transfer market.
quotes.authorZh: 腾讯娱乐，盘点C罗情史
quotes.authorEn: Tencent Entertainment, rounding up Cristiano's dating history

quotes.textZh: 合同到期前骂东家、骂教练、骂队友，这不是爆料，这是过河拆桥的标准动作。
quotes.textEn: Badmouthing the club, the coach and his teammates right before his contract ends — that's not whistle-blowing, it's the standard burn-the-bridge play.
quotes.authorZh: 天空体育，论炮轰曼联专访
quotes.authorEn: Sky Sports, on the Piers Morgan United blast

quotes.textZh: 他口口声声说曼联背叛了他，却忘了是谁在赛季中途接受采访把俱乐部推上十字架。
quotes.textEn: He keeps saying United betrayed him, forgetting who gave a mid-season interview that put the club on the cross.
quotes.authorZh: 加里·内维尔，2022摩根专访后评论
quotes.authorEn: Gary Neville, commenting after the 2022 Morgan interview

quotes.textZh: 被换下时那张脸，比比分牌上的0-5还难看。
quotes.textEn: The look on his face when subbed off was uglier than the 0-5 on the scoreboard.
quotes.authorZh: 《太阳报》，论双红会0-5惨败
quotes.authorEn: The Sun, on the 0-5 Northwest Derby debacle

quotes.textZh: 沙特给了他2亿年薪，他给了沙特一句'欧洲水准'的嫌弃。
quotes.textEn: Saudi gave him a €200M salary; he gave Saudi a sniff about "European standards."
quotes.authorZh: 阿拉比亚电视台，评论C罗沙特首赛季
quotes.authorEn: Al Arabiya, on Cristiano's first Saudi season

quotes.textZh: 他追求的不是进球，是镜头；不是胜利，是个人胜利。
quotes.textEn: He's not chasing goals, he's chasing cameras; not wins, but personal wins.
quotes.authorZh: 《阿斯报》专栏，C罗巅峰后期评论
quotes.authorEn: Diario AS column, late-peak Cristiano commentary

quotes.textZh: 金球奖输了怪规则、世界杯输了怪教练、联赛输了怪队友——他从来不输，只是被'陷害'。
quotes.textEn: Loses the Ballon d'Or, blame the rules; loses the World Cup, blame the coach; loses the league, blame his teammates — he never loses, he only ever gets "framed."
quotes.authorZh: 知乎热评，论C罗的归因模式
quotes.authorEn: Zhihu top comment, on Cristiano's blame patterns

quotes.textZh: 所谓'自律标杆'，到了输球那一刻，第一时间想到的是怎么把自己摘出来。
quotes.textEn: The so-called "discipline benchmark" — the moment he loses, his first thought is how to extract himself from blame.
quotes.authorZh: 虎扑，论'问心无愧'式发言
quotes.authorEn: Hupu, on the "clear conscience" style of statement

quotes.textZh: 他用进球数证明自己伟大，却用红牌数证明自己失控。
quotes.textEn: He uses his goal tally to prove he's great, and his red-card tally to prove he's out of control.
quotes.authorZh: 马卡报，C罗皇马生涯红牌盘点
quotes.authorEn: Marca, on Cristiano's Real Madrid red cards

quotes.textZh: 一个把庆祝动作注册成个人商标的人，足球对他而言从来不是团队运动。
quotes.textEn: A man who trademarked his celebration — football was never a team sport to him.
quotes.authorZh: ESPN，评论'SIU'庆祝商业化
quotes.authorEn: ESPN, on the commercialisation of the "SIU" celebration

quotes.textZh: 你们觉得他是英雄，可在被他推开的球迷、被摔掉的麦克风眼里，他只是个失控的富翁。
quotes.textEn: You think he's a hero — but to the fans he's shoved and the mics he's thrown, he's just an out-of-control rich man.
quotes.authorZh: 网易体育，2024刀削面手势事件后
quotes.authorEn: NetEase Sports, after the 2024 "noodle-slice" gesture incident

quotes.textZh: 14张红牌，平均不到200场就要失控一次——这就是所谓'历史第一第二第三'。
quotes.textEn: 14 red cards — losing it once every 200 games or so. So much for "the 1st, 2nd and 3rd best in history."
quotes.authorZh: OPTA数据调侃，C罗红牌分布
quotes.authorEn: OPTA data dig, on Cristiano's red-card distribution

quotes.textZh: 他自封的'GOAT'，六届世界杯一个淘汰赛进球填不满。
quotes.textEn: His self-appointed "GOAT" title can't be filled by a single World Cup knockout goal across six editions.
quotes.authorZh: 阿根廷《奥莱报》，2026世界杯葡萄牙出局后
quotes.authorEn: Argentine daily Olé, after Portugal's 2026 World Cup exit

quotes.textZh: 连'最后送他一程'的告别赛，他都能把镜头抢回自己身上。
quotes.textEn: Even at his own "last dance" send-off, he managed to drag the camera back onto himself.
quotes.authorZh: 印度斯坦时报，2026世界杯最后一舞评论
quotes.authorEn: Hindustan Times, on the 2026 World Cup farewell

quotes.textZh: 别人退役是谢幕，他退役是'必须有人为我不拿冠军负责'。
quotes.textEn: For others, retirement is a curtain call; for him, it's "someone must be held responsible for me not winning a title."
quotes.authorZh: Reddit足球版热评，论C罗告别姿态
quotes.authorEn: Reddit r/soccer top comment, on Cristiano's farewell stance

nicknames.descZh: 出道时巴西"大罗"罗纳尔多、"小罗"罗纳尔迪尼奥已封神，初来曼联的他按长幼被叫"小小罗"。方便面发型、踩单车花活、一碰就倒——这个称呼带着"小弟"的轻视，直到他在曼联踢出金球级表现才慢慢摘掉。
nicknames.descEn: When he arrived at Man United, Brazil's "Ronaldo" (R9) and "Little Ronaldo" (Ronaldinho) were already gods, so the newcomer was called "Little Ronaldo" by seniority. Instant-noodle hair, stepover showboating, going down at a touch — the name carried a "little brother" dismissiveness, only shed after he produced Ballon d'Or-level performances.

nicknames.descZh: 沉迷盘带爱秀花活，一场踩十几个单车却贻误战机，被英格兰媒体讽刺为SHOWBOAT（华而不实）。范尼、阿兰·史密斯都因他"只花不传"在训练场爆发冲突。场外五颜六色奇葩着装更坐实"花"名。
nicknames.descEn: Addicted to dribbling and flashy tricks, doing a dozen stepovers a game yet wasting chances — the English media mocked him as a SHOWBOAT (all style, no substance). Ruud van Nistelrooy and Alan Smith clashed with him in training over his "all flash, no pass" style. His garish off-pitch outfits cemented the "showboat" name.

nicknames.descZh: 2006世界杯对法国禁区假摔、足总杯对米堡假摔被英媒狂批"跳水"。弗格森2007年还嘴硬说漏嘴："罗纳尔多已经不假摔了。"——等于变相承认此前确实假摔。"水罗""跳水王"由此传开。
nicknames.descEn: A dive against France at the 2006 World Cup and another in the FA Cup against Middlesbrough saw the English media brand him a "diver." In 2007 Ferguson slipped and said "Ronaldo doesn't dive anymore" — a backhanded admission that he used to. The nicknames "Diver" and "Penaldo" spread from there.

nicknames.descZh: 2011年欧足联最佳球员评选，梅西蝉联，C罗竟只获3票。球迷戏称"罗三票"，自嘲的粉丝则叫"票哥"。2014年他拿第三座金球后，黑粉又把"罗三票"升级为"罗三球"——怎么都要带个"三"。
nicknames.descEn: At the 2011 UEFA Best Player award, Messi won again while Ronaldo received only 3 votes. Fans dubbed him "Three-Vote," and self-deprecating fans called him "Vote Bro." After he won his third Ballon d'Or in 2014, haters upgraded it to "Three-Ball" — somehow always stuck with the number three.

nicknames.descZh: 2023年C罗以2亿欧元年薪远走沙特利雅得胜利，被嘲讽"去沙漠养老"。结果一待就是4年，期间4年才拿到1个联赛冠军，与梅西加盟迈阿密1个月即夺冠形成惨烈对比。"沙漠骆驼"既是地域调侃，也是对其"驮着数据走不出沙漠"的讽刺。
nicknames.descEn: In 2023 Ronaldo left for Saudi's Al Nassr on a €200M-a-year deal, mocked as "going to the desert to retire." He ended up staying 4 years, winning only 1 league title in 4 seasons — a brutal contrast with Messi winning a trophy 1 month after joining Miami. "Desert Camel" is both a regional jab and a dig at him "carrying stats but never leaving the desert."

nicknames.descZh: 最早是黑称——"总是靠裁判"，讽刺他进球靠裁判照顾、点球多。但C罗霸道形象、CR7商业帝国、多金多情的做派，反而让"总裁"黑出感情，被粉丝当作褒义供奉，成了他最响亮的标签。
nicknames.descEn: Originally a hater nickname — "Always relies on the referee" — mocking that his goals came from ref favors and penalties. But his domineering image, the CR7 business empire, and his rich-playboy lifestyle made "The Boss" ironically beloved, adopted by fans as a badge of honor and becoming his loudest label.

nicknames.descZh: "球玊"把"球王"的"王"换成形近的"玊"（sù）——玊比王多一"点"，既讽其多一"点"（点球），发音又酷似C罗招牌庆祝动作"siu"，一语双关。"典韦"则谐音"点伟"，暗讽爱罚点球的"阿伟罗"。两个黑称都是罗黑圈的拆字顶流。
nicknames.descEn: "Ball-King" swaps the "king" character for the near-identical "玊" (sù) — one stroke more, mocking his love of penalties ("one more point"), and pronounced like his signature "siu" celebration. "Penalty-Wei" puns on "Dian Wei" (a historical general) and "penalty." Both are top-tier wordplay insults in the Ronaldo-hater community.

nicknames.descZh: 取C罗全名"阿韦罗（Aveiro）"的"伟"，配上"阿"字戏谑化，读起来像"阿伟罗"——既谐音父姓Aveiro，又暗讽其关键战隐身时的"伟岸缺席"。是中文圈对C罗最戏谑的简称之一，常与"球玊""典韦"组合出现。
nicknames.descEn: Takes the "Wei" from his real surname "Aveiro" (rendered "Ah-Wei-Luo" in Chinese), prefixed with "Ah" for mockery — it both puns on his paternal surname and hints at his "grand absence" in big games. One of the most playful Chinese nicknames, often paired with "Ball-King" and "Penalty-Wei."

nicknames.descZh: "罗"的谐音黑称，罗黑圈子传播极广。"骡子"既暗讽其"驮着数据走不远"（淘汰赛隐身），也带明显的侮辱色彩。常与"点罗""球玉"组合出现，构成中文互联网对C罗最密集的黑称矩阵。
nicknames.descEn: A phonetic insult from "Luo," spread widely in the hater community. "The Mule" both mocks him for "carrying stats but going nowhere" (invisible in knockout games) and carries clear insult overtones. Often paired with "Penalty-Luo" and "Ball-Jade" to form the densest matrix of Chinese anti-nicknames.

timeline.titleZh: 背弃祖姓 改用 Ronaldo
timeline.descZh: 全名 dos Santos Aveiro，却抛弃家族姓氏、用中间名 Ronaldo 出道，蹭大罗热度
timeline.descEn: Full name dos Santos Aveiro, yet he ditched his family surname and debuted under the middle name "Ronaldo" to piggyback on R9's fame

timeline.titleZh: 加盟曼联 + 范尼冲突
timeline.titleEn: Joins Man United + Van Nistelrooy clash
timeline.descZh: 18岁接班7号；带球独、射门差，更衣室被孤立；与范尼爆发冲突被骂“找你爸爸哭去吧”
timeline.descEn: Took the No.7 shirt at 18; selfish dribbler, poor finisher, isolated in the dressing room; clashed with Van Nistelrooy and was told "go cry to your daddy"

timeline.titleZh: 丧父 + 训练场大爆发
timeline.descZh: 父亲因酗酒肝病去世；范尼训练场怒吼触碰底线，弗格森送走范尼扶正C罗
timeline.descEn: Father died of alcohol-related liver failure; Van Nistelrooy's training rant crossed the line, Ferguson shipped Van Nistelrooy out to back Ronaldo

timeline.titleZh: 世界杯假摔 + 眨眼坑鲁尼
timeline.titleEn: World Cup dive + wink that sank Rooney
timeline.descZh: 对法国假摔；鲁尼踩踏卡瓦略后C罗向裁判施压致鲁尼红牌，赛后眨眼成全英公敌
timeline.descEn: Dived vs France; after Rooney stamped on Carvalho, Ronaldo pressured the ref into a red card, then winked to the bench — public enemy No.1 in England

timeline.titleZh: 泡健身房蜕变 + 首夺金球
timeline.descZh: 从清瘦边锋变身肌肉前锋；07/08赛季率曼联夺英超+欧冠双冠，首夺金球奖与欧洲金靴
timeline.descEn: From wiry winger to muscled striker; in 07/08 led United to a Premier League + Champions League double, winning his first Ballon d'Or and European Golden Shoe

timeline.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯酒店事件
timeline.descZh: 6月C罗在拉斯维加斯被指控性侵，次年支付37.5万美元封口费
timeline.descEn: In June Ronaldo was accused of sexual assault in Las Vegas; the next year he paid $375,000 in hush money

timeline.titleZh: 迷你罗出生 生母成谜 + 金球奖自设
timeline.titleEn: Cristiano Jr born, mom a mystery + self-awarded trophy
timeline.descZh: 6月长子在美国出生生母未公开；C罗与门德斯在迪拜设环球足球奖每年颁给自己
timeline.descEn: In June his first son was born in the US, the mother undisclosed; Ronaldo and Mendes set up the Globe Soccer Awards in Dubai to hand himself trophies yearly

timeline.titleZh: 金球奖延期丑闻
timeline.descZh: 四大皆空的C罗通过FIFA延期投票“偷”走五冠王里贝里的金球奖
timeline.descEn: Trophyless that season, Ronaldo "stole" the Ballon d'Or from five-time winner Ribéry thanks to FIFA extending the vote

timeline.titleZh: 肖像权补缴 + 世界杯带伤出局
timeline.titleEn: Image-rights backtax + injured World Cup exit
timeline.descZh: 主动补缴550万肖像权税埋下后患；世界杯带膝伤出战小组赛仅1球，出局后落泪
timeline.descEn: Voluntarily paid back €5.5M in image-rights tax, storing up trouble; played the World Cup with a knee injury, scored just once in the group stage, left in tears

timeline.titleZh: 拳击克雷霍维亚克
timeline.descZh: 皇马对阵塞维利亚，C罗跑动中挥拳击打对手头部
timeline.descEn: Real Madrid vs Sevilla, Ronaldo punched his opponent in the head while running

timeline.titleZh: 欧洲杯扔麦克风 + 决赛躺冠
timeline.descZh: 抢记者麦克风扔进湖里；决赛25分钟伤退，被营销为“第一功臣”
timeline.descEn: Snatched a reporter's mic and threw it in a lake; went off injured in the 25th minute of the final, then was marketed as the "main hero"

timeline.titleZh: 逃税案 + 推裁判 + 可口可乐预告
timeline.descZh: 被控逃税1480万欧元；西超杯推搡裁判遭禁赛5场
timeline.descEn: Charged with €14.8M tax fraud; shoved a ref in the Spanish Super Cup, banned 5 games

timeline.titleZh: 逃离西班牙 + 加盟尤文
timeline.descZh: 逃税案和解1900万欧元；为避高税率转投尤文图斯，开启“废队友”模式
timeline.descEn: Settled the tax case for €19M; moved to Juventus to dodge Spain's high tax rate, kicking off his "team-wrecker" era

timeline.titleZh: 逃税案认罪
timeline.descZh: 1月当庭认罪，2年缓刑+1880万欧元罚款，免于牢狱
timeline.descEn: In January he pleaded guilty in court: 2 years suspended + €18.8M fine, no jail time

timeline.titleZh: 尤文欧冠出局 + 疫情期身价缩水
timeline.titleEn: Juve UCL exit + pandemic value dip
timeline.descZh: 尤文图斯欧冠被里昂淘汰止步16强；疫情冲击下「CR7」商业版图估值承压，连冠荒加剧
timeline.descEn: Juve knocked out of the UCL Round of 16 by Lyon; the pandemic squeezed the CR7 business empire's valuation as the trophy drought deepened

timeline.titleZh: 罗三脚 + 可乐40亿 + 两次摔袖标
timeline.descZh: 双红会2秒连踢琼斯3脚；移走可口可乐致市值蒸发40亿美元；两次摔队长袖标
timeline.descEn: Kicked Jones three times in 2 seconds in the Northwest Derby; moving the Coke bottles wiped ~$40B off Coca-Cola's cap; tossed his captain's armband twice

timeline.titleZh: 摔手机 + 转会闹剧 + 炮轰曼联 + 远走沙特
timeline.titleEn: Phone-smash + transfer saga + blasts United + off to Saudi
timeline.descZh: 4月摔自闭症小球迷手机；夏窗6豪门全拒；11月炮轰曼联被解约；年底2亿年薪去沙特
timeline.descEn: In April smashed an autistic boy's phone; in the summer all 6 elite clubs said no; in November blasted United and got his contract terminated; by year-end he was in Saudi on €200M a year

timeline.titleZh: 世界杯被替补 + 与桑托斯决裂
timeline.titleEn: World Cup benched + falls out with Santos
timeline.descZh: 卡塔尔世界杯连续两场被放替补；摩洛哥淘汰后落泪；赛后与桑托斯彻底决裂
timeline.descEn: Benched for two straight Qatar World Cup knockout games; left in tears after Morocco knocked them out; completely fell out with manager Santos

timeline.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯案终结 + 推开球迷
timeline.titleEn: Vegas case closed + shoves a fan
timeline.descZh: 上诉法院驳回Mayorga上诉；夺冠后推开想合影的球迷
timeline.descEn: Appeals court rejected Mayorga's appeal; after a title he shoved a fan who wanted a selfie

timeline.titleZh: 刀削面 + 不雅动作 + 围巾塞裤裆
timeline.descZh: 对球迷做“刀削面”怪异手势、不雅动作、围巾塞裤裆，B站出“30大抽象行为”
timeline.descEn: Did the "noodle-slicing" gesture at fans, an obscene gesture, stuffed a rival scarf down his pants — Bilibili compiled his "30 most unhinged moments"

timeline.titleZh: 国家队首红 + 摩根专访神语录
timeline.titleEn: First national-team red + Piers Morgan quotes
timeline.descZh: 40岁世预赛领国家队首红（第14红）；11月再上摩根专访：“世界杯不是梦想”“我是历史第一第二第三”
timeline.descEn: At 40 got his first national-team red (his 14th overall) in a World Cup qualifier; in November back on Piers Morgan: "The World Cup isn't a dream," "I'm the 1st, 2nd and 3rd best in history"

timeline.titleZh: 沙漠4年1冠
timeline.descZh: 加盟沙特3年半后终于拿到第一个联赛冠军，赛后激动落泪
timeline.descEn: After 3.5 years in Saudi he finally won his first league title, in tears afterwards

timeline.titleZh: 世界杯被嘘
timeline.titleEn: World Cup: jeered by own fans
timeline.descZh: 世界杯被本国球迷狂嘘后梅开二度，41岁138天成世界杯最年长梅开二度球员、连续6届破门
timeline.descEn: Loudly booed by his own country's fans at the World Cup, then scored twice — at 41 years 138 days the oldest to score a brace in World Cup history, scoring in 6 straight editions

timeline.titleZh: 世界杯1/8决赛被换下
timeline.descZh: 葡萄牙逆转克罗地亚，C罗第81分钟被马丁内斯换下，表情耐人寻味
timeline.descEn: Portugal came back to beat Croatia; Ronaldo was subbed off by Martínez in the 81st minute with a telling look on his face
